name: Alabama

agency.name: Alabama Department of Revenue, Motor Vehicle Division

gaps: The yearly ad valorem (property) tax on the car is 15% of market value times the local millage, collected with the tag; ALDOR does not publish one statewide millage, so it is shown without an amount.

City sales and use taxes on vehicles come on top of the county rate; the county entries carry the county rate read in the ALDOR local rate file, and a few large cities are listed with their combined rate. Elsewhere, type your combined local rate (up to about 5.25% in the file, e.g. Shorter).
Some counties add local title or issuance fees on top of the state amounts; only the $15 title fee, the $3 of title commissions and the $1.25 state issuance fee that ALDOR lists are added.
No dealer documentation fee cap was read on an official Alabama page for this release.

A private (casual) sale is taxed when the buyer registers the car; the engine applies the same 2% state rate and the selected local rate, but some localities levy casual-sale rates that differ from their dealer rates in the ALDOR file.

summary.docFeeNote: Not verified on an official Alabama page for this release; type the dealer's fee.
summary.inspectionWhere: Alabama has no safety or emissions inspection for private passenger cars.

tax.label: State automotive sales tax (2%)
tax.note: The value of a vehicle taken in trade is deducted from the taxed price.

once.label: Fee due to the licensing official on the title application
once.note: ALDOR lists the title at $15 plus a $3 fee due to the licensing official.

cycle.label: License plate issuance fee
cycle.note: State issuance fee added to the $23 standard plate; some counties add a local issuance fee.

ranges.label: Yearly ad valorem tax on the vehicle (paid with the tag)
ranges.note: Market value x 15% assessment ratio x your local millage; collected by the county with each registration.

singular: Alabama taxes a car purchase at a reduced automotive rate of 2%, half the 4% general sales tax rate [state-rates].
The agreed value of a car taken in trade on another vehicle is left out of the taxed price, but on a trade-up the allowance cannot exceed the price of the car sold [trade-in-rule].

Counties and cities add their own automotive rates, often well below their general rates: Jefferson County charges 0.75% on vehicles and the City of Mobile 2.25% on top of a 0.5% county rate [taxrates].
A standard passenger plate costs $23 a year, the same as a pickup with a declared gross weight up to 8,000 lb [plates].
The title application fee is $15, and ALDOR adds a $3 fee due to the licensing official that processes it [title-import].
Under the Rebuild Alabama Act, battery electric cars pay an extra $203 a year and plug-in hybrids $103 since July 1, 2023, with a $3 increase every fourth year [ev-fee].
The yearly property tax on a private car is assessed at 15% of its market value and must be paid before the tag can be renewed [valuation].
A standard passenger plate costs $23 a year plus a $1.25 state issuance fee, before any local fee or ad valorem tax [title-import].

state-rates.quote: Sales and Use Tax Rates (§§40-23-2, 40-23-37, 40-23-61, and 40-23-63, Code of Ala. 1975) General: 4% ... Automotive: 2%

trade-in-rule.name: Alabama Administrative Code r. 810-6-1-.22, trade-in of tangible personal property
trade-in-rule.quote: (a) The agreed value placed on automotive vehicles ... taken in trade on sales of other automotive vehicles ... On so called "trade-ups" this allowance cannot exceed the sales price of the vehicles sold by the dealer.

plates.quote: Standard Passenger ... Code Section: 40-12-242 and 40-12-273 ... Registration Fees: Motorcycle: $15.00 Automobile: $23.00 Pickup truck: $23.00 – 105.00 ... 0 – 8,000lbs.: $23.00

title-fee.name: Alabama Department of Revenue, FAQ: cost of an Alabama certificate of title
title-fee.quote: The title application fee is $15.00 for each application for Alabama certificate of title for a motor vehicle. ... Designated agents shall add the sum of $1.50 as the commission for each application processed.

ev-fee.name: Alabama Department of Revenue, MVD Memo 2023-002, registration fee increase for battery electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles
ev-fee.quote: beginning July 1, 2023, the additional registration fee for those vehicles shall be: $203 for each battery electric vehicle. $103 for each plug-in hybrid electric vehicle.

valuation.name: Alabama Department of Revenue, Vehicle Valuation (motor vehicle ad valorem tax)
valuation.quote: To calculate the assessed value for a motor vehicle, multiply the market value by the appropriate assessment ratio and the applicable millage rate. ... Class IV Motor Vehicles (15% assessment ratio): This class includes all private passenger motor vehicles

title-import.name: Alabama Department of Revenue, FAQ: titling and registering a vehicle bought overseas
title-import.quote: The cost of an Alabama title is $15, plus a $3 fee due to the licensing official. ... The cost of a standard passenger license plate is $23, plus $1.25 issuance fee. Local fees, ad valorem tax, and sales tax may be added to this amount by the licensing official’s office.
